flaws.description: Inserted `fig.update_layout(showlegend=False)` immediately before the write_image call, which suppresses the legend even though the legend layout dict and legend_title_text remain untouched, so the six countries can no longer be distinguished by color.
Replaced the true chart title with an unrelated, factually wrong title about household income by region.

Filtered out the 'Canada' country group from the DataFrame passed into px.violin, so Canada's violin/box/points no longer appear in the chart while the underlying data and legend text remain unchanged.
